title: SUNDIVE: Moth & Flame
author: Lazarus71123
selftext:
SUNDIVE is an iOS mobile game created fully with Claude Code. It was made with an initial prompt that required for the agent to research market trends and opening within the mobile game space. It then created a game idea based on the found conclusions, and I allowed it to run in a repetitive self-checking loop until it was completed. 

Other than the initial prompt and some tweaking at the end, the only user input required was to OK the theme and the art direction. 

The art generation shocked me with how well it performed, and I ended up extracting the process that it used and creating an independent Claude skill for use in creating pixelated graphics, which I plan to upload to GitHub.
